examples.arabic: أنا أزورهم كثيرا وألاحظ دائما الانسجام الجميل بينهم.
examples.english: I visit them often and I always notice the beautiful harmony between them.
examples.transliteration: Ana azuruhum kathiran waulahidh daiman alinsijam aljamil baynahum.

examples.arabic: أليس المهرجان في ساحة الجامعة الرئيسية، حيث نجتمع دائماً لتبادل الأحاديث الثقافية المشتركة؟
examples.english: Isn't the festival in the main university square, where we always gather to exchange shared cultural conversations?
examples.transliteration: Alaysa al-mahrajan fee sahat al-jami'ah ar-ra'eesiyyah, haythu najtami'u da'iman li-tabadul al-ahadeeth ath-thaqafiyyah al-mushtarakah?
examples.storyTitle: An Appointment on Al Mutanabbi Street

examples.arabic: فهم الناس في السوق هذا الاختلاف بين الاجيال دائما
examples.english: The people in the market always understood this difference between generations.
examples.transliteration: Fahima an-nas fi as-suqi hadha al-ikhtilaf bayna al-ajyal da'iman.

examples.arabic: هذه اللحظات العائلية هي الأجمل دائما
examples.english: These family moments are always the most beautiful
examples.transliteration: Hadhihi al-lahazat al-'ailiyyah hiya al-ajmalu da'iman

examples.arabic: تعلم الاب شيئا جديدا وادرك ان الزمن يتطور دائما
examples.english: The father learned something new and realized that time always evolves.
examples.transliteration: Ta'allama al-abu shay'an jadeedan wa adraka anna az-zamana yatatawwaru daa'iman.
examples.storyTitle: Daily Challenge: Returning to the Shop

examples.arabic: عيناه واسعتان متعجبتان دائما تبحثان عن اجابات
examples.english: His eyes are wide with wonder, always looking for answers.
